# Databricks Memory

Your agents remember what matters across conversations, in Databricks managed memory that you own and govern.

## Getting started

1. Add the **Databricks** plugin and sign in under **Settings → Databricks**.
2. Ask any agent to remember something, like "remember that I prefer charts over tables".
3. Review or forget memories in **Settings → Databricks Memory**, and choose a shared store to share memory with your Databricks agents.
